name: Hospital Operations Command Center
tagline: Coordinates scheduling, beds, staffing, patient flow, claims support, and clinical admin documents with privacy controls.

orchestrator.job: Detects operational bottlenecks and routes work across scheduling, resources, patient flow, claims, and documentation while minimizing PHI access.

agents.job: Balances appointment slots, no-shows, and physician calendars.
deliverables: Balances appointment slots, no-shows, and physician calendars

agents.job: Tracks beds, rooms, staff, and equipment constraints.
deliverables: Tracks beds, rooms, staff, and equipment constraints

agents.job: Finds bottlenecks from intake to discharge.
deliverables: Finds bottlenecks from intake to discharge

agents.job: Prepares coding and claim-support evidence for review.
deliverables: Prepares coding and claim-support evidence for review

agents.job: Checks PHI minimization, consent, and clinical note safety.
deliverables: Checks PHI minimization, consent, and clinical note safety

reviewGates: Never print private data or secrets
Fall back to safe local drafts on failure
costGuardrails: Use standard or lower for collection and cleanup
Block repeated runs on same input
selfImprovement: Logs run outcomes, failure causes, and user edits into a memory ledger, then updates checklists and eval criteria.

benchmark.selectionRule: highest score, shortest wall time as tie-breaker
